fusions.name: Night Feeding
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bellowing Echo
fusions.desc: You bellow a cone of sound 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage and stunning each enemy for 0.8 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flit Beneath
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: After Dusk
fusions.desc: At night, your damage rises by 12%.
